instruction:
Solve the Permutation Flowshop Scheduling Problem (PFSP) with 8 jobs and 7 machines. Each machine can process only one job at a time and each job can be processed by only one machine at a time. Jobs must be processed on each machine in the same order. Identify the job order that minimizes the maximum completing time. The input includes the processing times of each machine on every jobs, the jobs with lowest processing time for each machines, and their respective processing times. Provide the solution in the following format:

1. Order: List the order that jobs are processed on each machine.
2. Objective: The objective value (maximum completing time).
